notes: 13 cases: 7 positive / 6 negative. Positives cover building from mechanism in five fields, auditing an existing simulation, and the quoted-number check; the skill's name is kept out of the prompts so this measures description matching. Negatives are the NOT-FOR clause as near-misses: a stylised effect, a policy rollout, a learned surrogate, an existing solver, ordinary testing, and UI motion.
